what: Goldman Sachs advises on mergers, helps companies raise money, trades stocks, bonds, currencies and commodities for clients, and manages money for institutions and wealthy individuals.
customers: Corporations, governments, investment funds and wealthy families.
money: trading, financing and investment banking fees
moat: A top brand and client relationships in deal-making and trading, and scale in alternative investments.
risks: Deal and trading activity is cyclical
opportunities: Revenue grew about 9% last year with a 29% net margin
Analysts see about 19% upside from current levels
A recovery in mergers and public listings would lift its most profitable business
watch: Investment banking fee backlog and return on tangible equity.
